description: This file defines an ApiService class providing methods to interact with a backend API for authentication, transaction management, and budget management in a financial tracking application. It includes functions for login, registration, adding/editing transactions, and adding/editing budgets, utilizing HTTP requests with authorization tokens stored in shared preferences.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A service class that manages API interactions related to authentication, transactions, and budgets for a financial application.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends a POST request to authenticate the user and retrieves an access token if successful.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Sends a POST request to register a new user account.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Sends a POST request to create a new financial transaction with specified details.

methods.name: editTransaction
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to update an existing transaction identified by its ID.

methods.name: addBudget
methods.description: Sends a POST request to add a new budget category with a specified limit.

methods.name: editBudget
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to update a budget category identified by its ID.
